status: unverified skeleton (2026-11-07): nothing here has been run; every null field needs a survey or an OSM lookup, named in the matching *_todo entry

site.name: Bundaran Hotel Indonesia (Bundaran HI)
site.city: Jakarta Pusat (Menteng / Tanah Abang), DKI Jakarta
site.centre_note: approximate map centre of the roundabout; move it to the signal nodes once the raw network is built
site.osm_bbox_s_w_n_e_todo: written by build_net.bbox(radius_km) around the centre; record it after the first download
site.osm_extract_timestamp_todo: copy osm_base from the downloaded .osm.xml header and pin the file
site.network_sha256_todo: sha256 of the final .net.xml, stamped by generate.py into config.json
site.junction_type: signalised roundabout (to confirm on site: APILL heads on each approach under Dishub DKI's ATCS); the ring itself carries the conflicts

context.mrt: MRT Jakarta Bundaran HI station is underground, so the viewer's viaduct model (mrt.py RAIL_Z 14 m) does not apply; disable --no-mrt or model nothing
context.busway: TransJakarta Corridor 1 runs in the median of Thamrin/Sudirman through the roundabout with its own signal heads; not modelled at Fatmawati, needs a bus-lane edge class and a signal group
context.odd_even: odd-even plate restriction on Thamrin/Sudirman on weekday peaks (check the current hours before counting)
context.car_free_day: Sunday mornings the roundabout is closed to motor traffic; do not count on Sundays
context.traffic_engineering_2022: since 19 July 2022 Dishub DKI closes the Sudirman -> Imam Bonjol movement every day 16:00-21:00 (TransJakarta and VVIP exempt); the pm peak therefore has a different movement set from the am peak
context.toll_road: none; the Fatmawati viewer's JORR flyover code (jorr.py, geometry3d.flyover) is unused here

junction.crossings_todo: cluster/node ids of every signalised ring node, read from the raw network after build_net at the new centre; the Fatmawati code holds exactly two (CROSSINGS) and a two-entry MEDIAN dict, so this is where the stage model must be generalised
junction.legs_note: provisional: N = Jl. MH Thamrin toward Monas, S = Jl. MH Thamrin / Jl. Jend. Sudirman, E = Jl. Imam Bonjol (east-south-east), W = Jl. Kebon Kacang Raya; confirm from the OSM extract, and check whether the ring has more than four stop lines
junction.approaches_todo: first edge of each leg that ends at a ring stop line (raw ids)
junction.median_todo: ring segments between consecutive stop lines play the role of Fatmawati's median links; there are as many as there are signalised ring nodes
junction.exits_todo: first edge leaving the ring on each leg
junction.leg_source_todo: upstream end of each leg inside the 2.7 km box
junction.leg_sink_todo: far end of each exit inside the box
junction.deleted_connections_todo: (from, to) link pairs netconvert deletes, written symbolically like stage_links (approach:S, exit:E, median:<name>, *): movements that are banned or uncounted (e.g. Sudirman -> Imam Bonjol in the evening programme)
junction.lanes_at_stop_line_todo: count from the raw network; Thamrin/Sudirman carry 4-5 general lanes plus the busway per direction

signal.stages_todo: stage list from a Dishub ATCS plan or a stopwatch survey (3+ cycles per period, am peak, midday, pm peak); the 2022 evening programme is a separate plan
signal.yellow_s_todo: amber per stage change, from the survey or the ATCS plan (Fatmawati's plan uses 2 s)
signal.allred_s_todo: all-red per stage change, from the survey or the ATCS plan (Fatmawati's plan uses 2 s)
signal.cycle_s_todo: sum of greens + stages x (amber + all-red); check against the stopwatch cycle
signal.stage_links_todo: (from edge, to edge or *) pairs per stage, including the ring segments; Fatmawati's amber/all-red builder only knows approach and median links
signal.stage_approaches_todo: approaches served in each stage, from stage_links
signal.stage_of_approach_todo: Fatmawati assumes one stage serves all of an approach's signalised traffic; a ring may serve one approach in two stages (then follow the E-leg q_veh_E_S1S2 pattern)
signal.stage_label_todo: plain-language stage names for the data dictionary and the DATACARD
signal.plant_note: the adaptive plant limits are design choices, kept from Fatmawati unless the surveyed plan exceeds them

demand.movements_veh_h_todo: classified turning count, one weekday peak hour in 15-min bins, every entry leg x exit leg pair including U-turns round the ring (16 with four legs); Dishub's only public figure (ANTARA, June 2022: about 98 thousand vehicles two-way, period not stated) is not a movement count
demand.mix_todo: from the same count by class; fallback 0.70 motorcycle (Jakarta-wide, Yusuf & Isradi 2025), which Fatmawati already uses as a sensitivity level; expect fewer motorcycles and more buses than Fatmawati on Thamrin
demand.windows_note: the pm window falls inside the 16:00-21:00 movement ban
demand.ev_legs_todo: legs with a route to the chosen hospital

calibration.target_max_queue_m_todo: per approach, the longest queue in the peak hour, measured the VISSIM way (speed < 5 km/h, gaps <= 20 m, from the stop line); no published value exists for Bundaran HI
calibration.queue_definition: VISSIM queue counter: speed < 5 km/h, contiguous from the stop line with gaps <= 20 m
calibration.pkji_delay_s_todo: optional: PKJI 2023 control delay per approach from the count and plan, used for validation text only
calibration.pkji_ds_todo: optional: PKJI 2023 degree of saturation per approach, validation text only
calibration.vissim_junction_delay_s_todo: optional: a published junction mean delay to validate against; none exists for Bundaran HI
calibration.fitted_scale_todo: written by calibrate.py into calibration.json once queue targets exist

sensors.gate_r_m_todo: 150 m from the centre unless a slip road or U-turn loop leaves the leg earlier; the ring is roughly 100 m across, so check that 150 m is outside it
sensors.camera_note: sensors.build_layout walks same-street-name chains; Thamrin has side streets and frontage roads, so confirm the walk reaches 300 m on every leg (tests/test_fatmawati.py asserts it)
sensors.sat_flow_pcu_h_todo: 600 x approach width per PKJI 2023, computed by sensors.py from the network; note learn.py falls back to Fatmawati's values (see docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md known issues)

evaluation.hospital_name_todo: pick from OSM amenity=hospital inside the box; candidates to check: RSPAD Gatot Soebroto (north-east), RS Bunda Menteng and RS Abdi Waluyo (east via Imam Bonjol); demand.hospital_edge filters on a street name, so record the street too
evaluation.hospital_lonlat_todo: OSM amenity=hospital coordinates of the chosen hospital
evaluation.hospital_street_name_todo: OSM street name of the hospital's edge (demand.hospital_edge filters on it)
evaluation.hospital_leg_todo: the leg whose exit gate ends an ambulance passage (the hospital side)
evaluation.ev_moves_todo: release legs with a route to the hospital through the ring; the Fatmawati routes (free-left slip, toll-ramp U-turn) do not exist here
evaluation.ev_stage_todo: per release leg, the stage its ambulance waits for at the stop line (null for an unsignalised slip); needs the stage plan
evaluation.release_points_todo: written by evaluate.py: edge, position and 400 m distance per release leg
evaluation.t_empty_s_todo: measured by evaluate.py with the signal off

gates.safety: no significant rise in lane collisions per veh-km above the fixed plan

evaluation.gates_note: pre-register before any Bundaran HI result is seen, as the Fatmawati gates were

viewer_only.jorr_ends_todo: not applicable: no toll road crosses Bundaran HI
viewer_only.mrt_rail_z_m_todo: not applicable: the MRT is underground here
viewer_only.buildings_file_todo: no downloader exists in the code; fetch building footprints within 1600 m by hand from Overpass
viewer_only.tomtom: display only, key from TOMTOM_API_KEY, nothing stored

known_differences_from_fatmawati: a signalised ring instead of two crossings 51 m apart: the stage model (build_net.STAGE_LINKS, MEDIAN, the amber/all-red builder, the % 4 cycle order) must be generalised before anything runs
possibly more than four stop lines on the ring; the N/E/S/W leg set is fixed in sensors, sumo_world, kpi, learn, generate and the tests
a median busway with its own signal heads
no toll flyover, an underground MRT
no published movement counts, signal plan or queue lengths: a field survey comes first
an evening movement ban that makes the pm peak a different network from the am peak
